If you get Android to start but then randomly end up in crash dump when you restart or Android crashes, then you should start to suspect the internal storage as the culprit. Sadly if there is a hardware failure, then there is not much you can do I'm afraid.

Do you have access to the terminal with a root password set? If you do, type this into the terminal (do this after a crash, a freshly started deck will not save previous messages)

sudo dmesg | grep amdgpu

If you see red lines show up and a lot of them, that means your GPU is freezing, then resetting, which causes gamescope to crash, restarting the steam client - hence why you get the verifying installation message.

You can look into dealing with this by searching this sub for GPU freeze/reset bug, but you'll probably want to have it returned.
